value.rationale: The ordinary matching complex of the regular octahedron is a natural small object with a full rank-three reflection symmetry. Its entire eleven-dimensional rational homology representation, inversion parity split (3,8), and absence of fixed classes are genuinely structural equivariant data not determined by the circle-wedge homotopy type or generic complete-graph modules. It is a motivated finite base case, with no unsupported family theorem.

final_claim: The ordinary matching complex of K_{2,2,2} is a wedge of eleven circles with the explicitly determined full rational S4×C2 homology character and four Specht summands.
